package turret_test
import "core:testing"
import "core:reflect"
import "core:os"
import r "godot:replay"
import net "godot:replay/net"
import game "../../../examples/replay_scrapyard/shared/game"
import upgrade "../../../examples/replay_scrapyard/shared/upgrade"
import scenario "godot:replay/testing"

TURRET :: u8(7)
Input :: struct {mount,release,deploy,fire:[game.SEATS]bool,move:[game.SEATS][2]f32,target:r.Handle(game.Turret)}
step :: proc(w:^game.World,input:Input,ctx:^r.Step(game.Event)) {
    for i in 0..<game.SEATS {
        if input.deploy[i] {game.cast_ability(w,u16(i+1),0,[2]f32{630,1040},true,ctx)}
        if input.release[i] {game.action(w,u16(i+1),game.Action{kind=.Turret_Dismount,turret=input.target},ctx)}
        if input.mount[i] {game.action(w,u16(i+1),game.Action{kind=.Turret_Mount,turret=input.target},ctx)}
    }
    controls:[game.SEATS]game.Control
    for &c,i in controls {c={move=input.move[i],aim={1,0},fire=input.fire[i]}}
    game.step(w,controls,0,0,ctx)
}
yard :: proc(ammo:u16=3)->game.World {
    w:=game.initial(encounter_count=0);w.stage=.Yard
    for &player,i in w.players[:2] {player.connected,player.in_yard=true,true;player.position={600,f32(1030+i*20)};player.profile.abilities={TURRET,2}}
    w.catalog.abilities[TURRET].turret.ammo=ammo;w.catalog.abilities[TURRET].turret.cadence=1
    return w
}
spawned :: proc(ammo:u16=3)->game.World {
    timeline:r.Timeline(game.World,Input,game.Event);assert(r.init(&timeline,r.Frame(game.World){state=yard(ammo)},step)==.None);defer r.destroy(&timeline)
    result:=r.advance(&timeline,Input{deploy={0=true}});assert(result.error==.None)
    frame,_:=r.current(&timeline);assert(frame.state.turrets.count==1);return frame.state
}
@(test)
shared_ammo_handoff_and_final_shot_dismount :: proc(t:^testing.T) {
    w:=spawned();target:=r.Handle(game.Turret){0,w.turrets.generations[0]}
    timeline:r.Timeline(game.World,Input,game.Event);assert(r.init(&timeline,r.Frame(game.World){tick=w.clock,state=w},step)==.None);defer r.destroy(&timeline)
    // Same tick claims have the normal deterministic seat ordering in this input.
    assert(r.advance(&timeline,Input{mount={0=true,1=true},target=target,fire={0=true}}).error==.None)
    frame,_:=r.current(&timeline)
    testing.expect(t,frame.state.turrets.values[0].operator.seat==1 && frame.state.turrets.values[0].ammo==2)
    p0:=frame.state.players[0].position
    assert(r.advance(&timeline,Input{move={0={1,0}},target=target}).error==.None)
    frame,_=r.current(&timeline);testing.expect_value(t,frame.state.players[0].position,p0)
    assert(r.advance(&timeline,Input{release={0=true},mount={1=true},fire={1=true},target=target}).error==.None)
    frame,_=r.current(&timeline);testing.expect(t,frame.state.turrets.values[0].operator.seat==2 && frame.state.turrets.values[0].ammo==1)
    assert(r.advance(&timeline,Input{fire={1=true},target=target}).error==.None)
    frame,_=r.current(&timeline)
    testing.expect(t,frame.state.turrets.count==0 && !game.turret_operator(&frame.state,2))
    testing.expect(t,frame.state.players[0].shots==1 && frame.state.players[1].shots==2,"last turret round must not also fire the handheld gun")
    testing.expect(t,game.state_valid(frame.state))
}
@(test)
rejects_stale_remote_and_occupied_targets :: proc(t:^testing.T) {
    w:=spawned();target:=r.Handle(game.Turret){0,w.turrets.generations[0]}
    testing.expect(t,game.turret_mount(&w,1,target))
    testing.expect(t,!game.turret_mount(&w,2,target) && !game.turret_dismount(&w,2,target))
    w.players[0].connected=false;game.turret_cleanup(&w)
    testing.expect(t,w.turrets.values[0].operator.seat==0 && game.turret_mount(&w,2,target))
    w.players[1].warp+=1;game.turret_cleanup(&w);testing.expect(t,!game.turret_operator(&w,2))
    assert(game.turret_mount(&w,2,target));w.players[1].generation+=1;game.turret_cleanup(&w)
    testing.expect(t,w.turrets.values[0].operator==(game.Credit{}))
    w.players[1].position={100,100};testing.expect(t,!game.turret_mount(&w,2,target))
    saved:=w.turrets.values[0];assert(r.pool_remove(&w.turrets,target))
    next,ok:=r.pool_insert(&w.turrets,saved);assert(ok)
    testing.expect(t,next.generation!=target.generation && !game.turret_mount(&w,2,target))
}

@(test)
placement_occlusion_capacity_and_muzzle_clearance :: proc(t:^testing.T) {
    w:=yard();w.layout.covers={};w.players[0].position={500,500}
    w.layout.covers[0]={x=520,y=480,w=20,h=40}
    events:[16]r.Occurrence(game.Event);ctx:=r.Step(game.Event){tick=1,epoch=1,events=events[:]}
    // Both intersecting cover and throwing through it reject without spending a cast.
    testing.expect(t,!game.cast_ability(&w,1,0,{530,500},true,&ctx))
    testing.expect(t,!game.cast_ability(&w,1,0,{560,500},true,&ctx))
    testing.expect(t,w.players[0].casts==0 && w.players[0].ability_cd[0].remaining==0 && w.turrets.count==0)
    testing.expect(t,!game.turret_deploy(&w,{500,500},255,{1,1},&ctx))
    testing.expect(t,!game.turret_deploy(&w,{0,500},TURRET,{1,1},&ctx))
    assert(game.cast_ability(&w,1,0,{500,500},true,&ctx))
    handle:=r.Handle(game.Turret){0,w.turrets.generations[0]}
    w.players[1].position={560,500}
    testing.expect(t,!game.turret_mount(&w,2,handle),"cannot operate through cover even within use radius")
    assert(game.turret_mount(&w,1,handle));w.players[0].aim={1,0}
    game.turret_fire(&w,1,&ctx)
    testing.expect_value(t,w.shots.values[0].position,[2]f32{512,500})
    feedback:game.Notices;game.shot_step(&w,&feedback,&ctx)
    testing.expect(t,w.shots.count==0,"first turret bullet must hit nearby cover")
    assert(game.turret_dismount(&w,1,handle))
    w.layout.covers={}
    // Capacity refusal leaves the already established cooldown/cast counts intact.
    for i in 1..<game.MAX_TURRETS {
        assert(game.turret_deploy(&w,{500+f32(i)*40,500},TURRET,{1,1},&ctx))
    }
    w.players[0].position={900,500};w.players[0].ability_cd[0]={}
    casts:=w.players[0].casts
    testing.expect(t,!game.cast_ability(&w,1,0,{900,500},true,&ctx))
    testing.expect(t,w.turrets.count==game.MAX_TURRETS && w.players[0].casts==casts && w.players[0].ability_cd[0].remaining==0)
}
@(test)
late_claim_correction_removes_predicted_shots_and_ammo_spend :: proc(t:^testing.T) {
    w:=spawned();target:=r.Handle(game.Turret){0,w.turrets.generations[0]}
    predicted,actual:[12]Input
    for &input in predicted {input.fire[0]=true;input.target=target}
    predicted[0].mount[0]=true
    for &input in actual {input.target=target};actual[0].mount[1]=true
    result:=scenario.correction(r.Frame(game.World){tick=w.clock,state=w},step,predicted[:],actual[:],w.clock+1)
    testing.expect(t,result.report.phase==.Complete && result.before.state.players[0].shots>0 && result.after.state.players[0].shots==0)
    testing.expect(t,result.after.state.turrets.values[0].ammo==3 && result.after.state.turrets.values[0].operator.seat==2)
}
@(test)
content50_checkpoint_upgrades_with_no_turret_or_occupation :: proc(t:^testing.T) {
    bytes,error:=os.read_entire_file("tests/replay_turret/fixtures/content50.checkpoint",context.allocator);assert(error==nil);defer delete(bytes)
    source:net.Checkpoint(upgrade.World_50,game.Control,upgrade.Action_50,game.SEATS);defer net.checkpoint_destroy(&source)
    assert(net.checkpoint_decode(&source,bytes,upgrade.model_50(),upgrade.CONTENT_50)==.None)
    converted,result:=upgrade.root_50(bytes);testing.expect_value(t,result,net.Error.None);defer delete(converted);if result!=.None {return}
    target:net.Checkpoint(game.World,game.Control,game.Action,game.SEATS);defer net.checkpoint_destroy(&target)
    assert(net.checkpoint_decode(&target,converted,game.model(),game.CONTENT)==.None)
    expected,ok:=upgrade.map_world_50(source.frame.state)
    testing.expect(t,ok && reflect.equal(target.frame.state,expected) && target.frame.state.turrets.count==0)
    for ability in target.frame.state.catalog.abilities {testing.expect_value(t,ability.turret,game.World{}.catalog.abilities[0].turret)}
}

@(test)
occupied_checkpoint_takeover_preserves_ammo_operator_and_cadence :: proc(t:^testing.T) {
    w:=spawned(5);w.catalog.abilities[TURRET].turret.cadence=10
    target:=r.Handle(game.Turret){0,w.turrets.generations[0]};assert(game.turret_mount(&w,1,target))
    cfg:=net.DEFAULT_CONFIG;cfg.content=game.CONTENT;model:=game.model();model.reset_player=nil
    drive:=proc(s:^net.Server(game.World,game.Control,game.Action,game.Event,game.SEATS),tick:u64)->net.Error {
        return net.server_local(s,game.Control{aim={1,0},fire=tick<=42})
    }
    result:=scenario.takeover(r.Frame(game.World){tick=w.clock,state=w},model,cfg,5,60,drive)
    testing.expect(t,result.report.phase==.Complete)
    testing.expect(t,result.before.state.turrets.values[0].operator.seat==1 && result.before.state.turrets.values[0].ammo==4 && result.before.state.turrets.values[0].next_shot==12)
    testing.expect(t,result.after.state.turrets.count==0 && result.after.state.players[0].shots==5 && !game.turret_operator(&result.after.state,1))
}
@(test)
mounted_actions_saturation_death_and_floor_cleanup :: proc(t:^testing.T) {
    w:=spawned();target:=r.Handle(game.Turret){0,w.turrets.generations[0]};assert(game.turret_mount(&w,1,target))
    timeline:r.Timeline(game.World,Input,game.Event);assert(r.init(&timeline,r.Frame(game.World){tick=w.clock,state=w},step)==.None);defer r.destroy(&timeline)
    events:[16]r.Occurrence(game.Event)
    ctx:=r.Step(game.Event){tick=w.clock+1,epoch=1,events=events[:]}
    testing.expect(t,!game.dash_start(&w,1,{1,0},&ctx) && !game.cast_ability(&w,1,1,{1,0},false,&ctx))
    ammo:=w.turrets.values[0].ammo
    for w.shots.count<game.MAX_SHOTS {_,ok:=r.pool_insert(&w.shots,game.Shot{kind=.Ballistic,seat=1,generation=1,serial=1,position={600,1040},velocity={1,0},ttl=40,damage=1});assert(ok)}
    game.turret_fire(&w,1,&ctx)
    testing.expect(t,w.turrets.values[0].ammo==ammo && w.players[0].shots==0 && w.turrets.values[0].next_shot==0)
    notices:game.Notices;game.hurt_player(&w,0,255,w.players[0].position,&notices,&ctx)
    testing.expect(t,!game.turret_operator(&w,1) && game.turret_mount(&w,2,target))
    game.turn_floor(&w,false,&ctx)
    testing.expect(t,w.turrets.count==0 && !game.turret_operator(&w,2))
}
